label: V-Neckline
description: V-neck waistcoat — the V point sits 8 cm to 14 cm below the neck point (10 cm to 12 cm on a five-button front), each side angled 25° to 40° from vertical. A narrowing funnel that lengthens the torso, enlarges the chest and directs the eye to the neckwear.
